quest.title: A Grueling Combat Simulation
quest.description: Talalikhin, an adventurer devoted to researching dangerous phenomena, is conducting some form of simulation training near the Adventurers' Guild headquarters...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Lesnova
dialogues.text: There's definitely something wrong with your balancing. Even if you brought in those combat specialists from the Special Assignments Battalion, nobody would be able to beat it!

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: Then train harder and reflect on your mistakes. It's not just a shooting simulation, either. Building defensive fortifications is just as important.

dialogues.speaker: Lesnova
dialogues.text: But when you demonstrated it yourself, didn't a single mistake cause the whole run to fall apart?

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: So what? That's exactly how dangerous the Shadow Realm should be.

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: If it's made even a little easier, ordinary marksmen will start having illusions of competence, thinking, "Maybe I could survive in the Shadow Realm."

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: So if you don't train to the strictest standards, how can you hope to perform flawlessly in such a brutal environment?

dialogues.speaker: Lesnova
dialogues.text: I'm gonna go figure this thing out. No way I'm getting shut out every single run.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oof, he really got the wind knocked out of his sails...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like your tabletop game really threw him for a loop.

choices.text: To be fair, a difficulty spike like that can be pretty stressful.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: A game? To you, maybe. A fun little pastime, even. But for those who know what the Shadow Realm is, the very premise of the combat simulation is enough to make them uneasy.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: I created it as a way to train strategic thinking through simulations.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: To the adventurers, hunters, and warriors of Snezhnaya, the Shadow Realm has always been a blade hidden deep within the snowstorms, waiting to strike.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: No one knows exactly what's inside. All we can do is piece together scattered scraps of information and try to imagine just how dangerous it might be.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Then we come up with hypothetical battle plans and use them to sharpen our skills. If we're ever unlucky enough to end up in that hellhole, at least we'd stand a better chance of making it out alive.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: The problem is, even at my best, I can barely survive a few rounds myself — so what chance do they have...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa... This is way more serious than Paimon was expecting.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Still, {NICKNAME} has a ton of experience with this stuff. Should have to be one of the best in Snezhnaya, right?

choices.text: If the pay is good enough...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: #That raises an important question: what's a fair price for an exclusive demonstration from you, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: I honestly have no idea. I'll start by paying the equivalent of three S-Rank commissions out of my own savings, then use the results to persuade the Guild to fund the project.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: And if that still isn't enough, I'll have to take out a loan from the Northland Bank...

choices.text: You don't need to go that far.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! If it's something that benefits everyone, we're not about to charge an arm and a leg for it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, we've never charged outrageous prices in the first place! Knowing we've helped a lot of people is reward enough for both of us.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: #Then I'd better rinse my eyes with ice water and brace myself for {NICKNAME}'s demonstration.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: So allow me to briefly explain the rules of the simulation...

choices.text: As long as the offer comes with genuine sincerity.
I could give everyone a demonstration.
You probably shouldn't expect such flawless execution.
